How it works

From a clear request to an agreed rate.

Share the right details

Add your role, equipment, authority or company details, preferred lanes, and the information another party needs to evaluate the move.

Offer or counter clearly

Shippers can post a target rate or leave it open. Providers can accept it or counter with a price and a short explanation.

Confirm the exact agreement

Before work starts, both parties can see the agreed rate, equipment, timing, included services, messages, and status in one place.

Transparent pricing without a race to the bottom

Every offer should explain the real cost of the move.

A low number without the right truck, loading plan, or appointment window is not a useful quote. Relocation Manager is designed to keep the rate and its terms together.

Atlanta, GA → Charlotte, NC Offers open
Shipper target: $950 26 ft box truck · Tomorrow · Liftgate needed
JRJ.R. Transport Carrier · Profile checks complete
$1,080 Counteroffer

Includes liftgate, driver assist, and a 9–11 AM pickup window.

✓ Rate and terms agreed

$1,025 Counteroffer

Choose the provider and terms that fit—not simply the lowest number.

Quick answers

Know what happens before you join.

Can a $9.99 shipper claim a load?

No. The shipper plan can post a pickup and review responses, but it cannot browse or claim other loads.

Can driver and fleet plans post loads too?

Yes. The $29.99 independent driver plan and all higher fleet plans can both post loads and find available work.

Does Relocation Manager guarantee a carrier, rate, or payment?

No. The platform keeps key details and offers together, but every party must independently verify identity, authority, insurance, equipment, freight details, terms, and payment before accepting work.

Can I cancel from my profile?

Yes. Subscription management and cancellation are available from the account profile through the secure billing portal.
